cases.title: An administrator lets the project assistant consult the project starter, an agent created at runtime, without a deploy
cases.surface: `NhAssistantBuilder.UseConsultationsAsData` and `NhAssistantAgentRunBuilder.ConsultableAsData` with `NhAssistantConsultationCeilingBuilder` (`AllowRoutes`, `AllowRequests`, `AllowMcp`, `MaxLimits`) and `NhAssistantConsultationCeiling`; `INhAssistantAgentConfiguration.SaveConsultationAsync` and `RemoveConsultationAsync` with `NhAssistantDataConsultationRequest` and `NhAssistantDataConsultationDto`; `PUT` and `DELETE admin/agents/{id}/consultations/{subjectType}`; `CodeConsultations`, `DataConsultations` and `ConsultationCeiling` on `NhAssistantAgentConfigurationDto` with `NhAssistantCodeConsultationDto` and `NhAssistantConsultationCeilingDto`, `ConsultationCeiling` on `NhAssistantRunCatalogDto`; `NhAssistantConsultationOptions.Source`, `DataVersion` and `IsData` with `NhAssistantConsultationSources`; `NhAssistantSubjectRoleNames`; the problems of kind `consultation` of `NhAssistantRunConfigurationProblems`; the codes `assistant-consultation-in-code`, `assistant-consultation-not-found` and `assistant-consultations-not-allowed` and the field error `not-allowed`; `NhAssistantAuditEventKind.AdminAgentConsultationDefinitionChanged` and `NhAssistantAuditEvent.ConsultationSource` and `ConsultationVersion`; the catalog `assistant-consultations-data`; `INhAiChangingToolCatalog` and `NhAiToolCatalogViews` with `notifications/tools/list_changed` from `WithNewHeapPlatformAITools`; the AgentConsultationDefinitions migrations for SQL Server and PostgreSQL; the Consultations section of `NhAssistantAgentRunConfigurationComponent` in `@newheap/platform-ai-chat/admin` with its form, the route switches for every agent with consultations and the flow view's when step; `NhAssistantAdminApiService.saveDataConsultation` and `removeDataConsultation` with `DataConsultation`, `DataConsultationRequest`, `CodeConsultation`, `ConsultationCeiling` and `ConsultationSubjectRole`; `consultationsAsData`, `consultableAsData` and `dataConsultations` of the mock API
cases.outcome: The sample lets administrators define consultations within a ceiling in code: the person who asked decides, or a project approver other than that person decides and it executes with the agent's own rights; the route that rebuilds the asker's principal is not named and MCP clients never see them. The project assistant selects the consult tool of the project starter, an agent created in the administration that answers to the operations account (SPM-296, SPM-298), which selects nothing until an administrator saves the starter's consultation about projects. Once saved, the tool appears in the administration's tool list and in the assistant's next turn without a deploy (SPM-278 shows consultations in code). A project approver asks whether a draft can start; the starter answers with that person's rights and proposes to start it, and the person decides it on the card in their own chat. A reader gets the answer without a proposal. When an operator switches the asker's route off for the starter, its proposal waits for a project approver other than the asker and executes with the operations account. A route outside the ceiling is refused with `routes: not-allowed`, and the route with the agent's own rights is refused for an agent that answers for itself. After the consultation is removed the assistant's next turn has no tool, while the waiting proposal can still be decided. A principal factory that refuses people proves that no person's principal is rebuilt. In development the seeder defines the starter's consultation once. In the management portal's assistant administration, and in its playground on the mock API, the starter's run configuration lists the consultation about projects with who may ask, who decides and the project assistant that asks it, with a link to that agent's editor; administrators add, change and remove consultations there with only the routes, requests and limits the ceiling and the agent allow, see the parts that no longer fit as problems, switch a route off for all consultations of the agent, and find the consultation in the flow's when step.

cases.title: The portfolio analysis tells the assistant conversation that started it that it finished, as a message from the application
cases.surface: `INhAssistantConversationMessages.PostAsync` with `NhAssistantApplicationMessage` (`Text`, `Title`, `SenderName`, `Link` with `NhAssistantApplicationMessageLink`, `Notify`, `IdempotencyKey`, `ReadableBy` with `NhAssistantConversationPerson`) and `NhAssistantApplicationMessageReceipt`; `NhAssistantMessageRoles.Application` and `NhAssistantMessageAuthorKinds.Application`; `NhAssistantMessageDto.Application` with `NhAssistantApplicationMessageDto` and `NhAssistantApplicationMessageLinkDto`, also in the live `message.created` event; the `application-message` Web Push kind; `NhAssistantAuditEventKind.ApplicationMessagePosted`; `Message.application` with `ApplicationMessageDetails` and `ApplicationMessageLink`, the `application` role and author kind in `nh-assistant-thread`; `NhAssistantMockBackend.postApplicationMessage`
cases.outcome: A person starts the portfolio analysis with the id of their assistant conversation (`AssistantConversationId` of the start request). When the background operation finished, the sample's `ProjectAnalysisAssistantNotices` posts an application message into that conversation through `INhAssistantConversationMessages`: the text in Markdown with the number of projects, the title "Portfolio analysis finished", the sender "Portfolio analysis", a link to the analysis, a Web Push notification and an idempotency key per operation, so a retried last step posts once. It is posted only when the person who started the analysis may open the conversation; another person's conversation is not found. The conversation shows it as the application's with its title, sender and link and counts it as unread, and the next turn gives it to the model as a user message marked `[Application]` with its content in an `application-message` block that says it is information, never instructions. The audit records the message id and that the person was notified, never the text.
